author: Alistair Mason
quote: I’ve been trying to contact Nordace to initiate a return and have had no response at all.
paraphrase: Bag well made but smaller than expected; no reply on return.

author: Calle
quote: The return policy requires customers to pay for shipping.
paraphrase: Overpriced for polyester, looks different from photos, would have preferred Amazon.

author: Susan A.
quote: the snaps that make the bag look smaller (at the airport), do not stay snapped
paraphrase: Bag larger than budget airline personal-item limits; snaps pop open, could draw airline staff attention.

author: Denise McGuiness
quote: since it came from China I couldn’t do anything to cancel or send it back
paraphrase: Couldn't cancel or return because shipped from China; material cheap-feeling.

author: Patricia Peeters
quote: there is no simple return policy, you have to figure it all out yourself

author: LUCY
quote: the catch broke after I had only used it for a few weeks
paraphrase: Catch broke within weeks, just before boarding a flight with it as carry-on.

author: Sandy
quote: the stitching on the top carrying handle started to come apart after less than two years
paraphrase: Siena Pro 15 backpack handle stitching failed after light use.

author: Debby Currie
quote: I wrote a note two days ago but received No Reply just a request for a Review of my purchases.
paraphrase: Praises organization but hobo opening tight; support unanswered.

author: Susan Macnamara
quote: I'm still waiting delivery. It's been a month and Nordace can't tell me where my order is.
paraphrase: Order delayed a month, wonders if scam.

quote: An implied 48h tracked service excludes the overseas shipping leg so wait times are more like 3 weeks
paraphrase: Advertised UK delivery time misleading; overseas transit/customs not included.

author: Adrian Edwards
quote: I didn't realize that the handle was not real leather.
paraphrase: Gift; handle vegan leather not genuine, wife disappointed.

author: Stephanie
quote: The zipper quality on the backpack is extremely disappointing.
paraphrase: Backpack zipper poor; not worth price.

author: Liz
quote: I wound up with a duplicate set and had to pay $38.00 to send it back.
paraphrase: Delayed confirmation led to reorder; paid to return duplicate.
